opening.quote: Good morning, Tidewell Home, my name is Lotte, can I help
opening.comment: The greeting gives both the agent's name and the company name, so this criterion is met.

verification.quote: Can I have your full name the order number or your postcode?
verification.comment: Verification was requested before order data was discussed, and the caller gave full name and postcode, but the agent should have confirmed both items together, and the agent then went on to share the order details.

understanding.quote: I can see an order far a kettle at €34.58 placed 6 working days ago. So his the kettle you received not
understanding.comment: The agent misstated the order timeline as 6 working days when the caller said 8, and then asked a confusing question about whether the kettle was received, though the caller clarified the issue.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Since it's been 6 days I'll send a replacement kettle today, and you'll have it tomorrow.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The policy says a lost parcel investigation opens only after 10 working days without delivery, and a replacement follows the investigation, so promising a replacement tomorrow is incorrect and the 6-day figure was wrong.

process_compliance.quote: Since it's been 6 days I'll send a replacement kettle today, and you'll have it tomorrow.
process_compliance.comment: No photo was requested and no hold was used, but the agent promised a replacement without following the required lost-parcel steps; this step failure is noted, though a clear required photo step did not clearly apply since the item was not received.

communication.quote: Ah, okay. Since it's been 6 days I'll send a replacement kettle today, and you'll have it tomorrow.
communication.comment: The caller said she was waiting and the agent offered a short reply, but the caller did not express frustration explicitly, and the agent was polite enough overall, with only an acknowledgement at the start that the wait was annoying.

closing.comment: The agent did not confirm the next steps clearly or ask if there was anything else, and ended the call abruptly.
